description: Read the recipes of one Supertoinette category, page by page. The category is a number and a name together, taken from list_categories or from the 'tags' of a recipe, and never assembled by hand. Each row carries the identifier get_recipe reads a recipe with, plus the difficulty and the total time the site prints beside it. The site publishes no total, so 'last_page' says how far the listing runs.

category.description: The category to read, as a number and a name together, such as '107/recettes-desserts'. Take one from list_categories or from a recipe's tags.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default. The site serves at most 30 to a page, and 'rows_published' always states what the page held.

page.description: Which page to read, 1 by default. 'last_page' says how far the listing runs.

name: browse_recipes

last_page.description: The highest page the site links to from this one.

page.description: The page these rows were read from.

difficulty.description: The site's own wording, or null where it printed none.

title.description: The title with the pictogram the site opens it with taken off.

total_minutes.description: Minutes, or null where the site printed no total.

url.description: The public page. Show this when citing the recipe.

rows_published.description: Rows the page held, before any were rendered.

title.description: The site's own heading for the category.

total_available.description: Supertoinette prints no total on a category page, so there is none to report.

url.description: The page these rows were read from.

title: Read one category's recipes
